faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Integrated Child Development Project Jagdalpur (Rural) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 27 November 2026. Applications opened on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Integrated Child Development Project Jagdalpur (Rural) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Anganwadi Sahayika (Rural) - Anganwadi Centre Bhatrapara (Bhatagudha), Gram Panchayat Ghatpadmur, 1 Anganwadi Sahayika (Urban) - Anganwadi Centre Dharmpura (Centre No. 01), Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ward No. 38, Municipal Corporation Jagdalpur.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Integrated Child Development Project Jagdalpur (Rural) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years (as on 11 November 2026). Relaxation: Workers and helpers with 1 year or more service experience 3 years in the maximum age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post is entirely honorary (mansevi) and non-governmental; no amount printed.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum 8th board pass; if no eligible candidate is found, 5th pass or literate women may also be considered under the rules. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only women can apply. Applicant must be a permanent resident of the concerned village (rural post) or the concerned ward (urban post).

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications sent directly or by registered post will not be considered. Applications received after the fixed date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Evaluation of applications with additional marks as per rules for BPL families, SC/ST women, experienced workers or helpers, and widowed, abandoned or divorced women. Additional marks are given as per rules to BPL family women, SC or ST women, experienced workers or helpers, and widowed, abandoned or divorced women.

faq.answer: The post is entirely honorary (mansevi) and non-governmental.
